entry.title: New: Bill 21 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 2, ARTICLE 15, OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO NEPOTISM

Adds provisions and definitions consistent with standards set forth in Section 84-13.2 of the Hawaiʻi Revised Statutes, which are intended to provide for fair and impartial hiring, personnel, and contracting practices within the workplace.

Latest action: Council: Bill 21, Draft 2 passes second & final reading - 5/7/25
